contract.architecture: Contrato técnico documental v1 consolidado por Codex con decisiones de negocio del usuario v02. Único stack propuesto: React/Vite TypeScript FE, Fastify TypeScript API, PostgreSQL persistencia. Justificación: base inventariada contiene controlador/piloto Python, sin FE/API SaaS; Node22.18.0/npm10.9.3 disponibles; API/FE separados del controlador Python3.12.14 que permanece. Pins de dependencias y BD ausentes bloquean ejecución. Recorrido: visitante filtra directorio y abre WhatsApp del perfil; persona adulta se registra, completa perfil, sube fotos y activa plan de prueba para publicar. Un perfil por cuenta. Roles de autorización: member propietario, sin admin de producto en esta vertical. Basic/promoted son planes comerciales, nunca permisos. Directorio global público, no tenants organizacionales; escrituras y datos privados aislados por user_id autenticado. No chat/matching/likes. Dev/staging simulado, Rebill al final AGE-40. AGE-30/32 integración pendiente; contrato puede prepararse en paralelo. Todos los defaults técnicos aquí son propuestas para implementación; negocio confirmado Argentina ARS15000/30000 por mes calendario, cualquier género y18+. Fecha declarada se valida, no demuestra identidad ni verificación documental de edad. UI rutas /, /personas/:profile_id, /registro, /ingresar, /recuperar, /restablecer, /mi-perfil, /mi-plan en ui-contract.json. Raíz pública agrupa la página por plan: sección identificada Promocionados arriba y Listado básico debajo, sin repetir tarjetas, ambos con mismos filtros. Estados vacío/error/carga y verificación móvil360px/1280px especificados, no ejecutados.
contract.auth: Public register/login/forgot/reset; refresh authenticates cookie, all /api/me/* and activation except production early guard require valid access session. JWT signed server key reference, exp15min, sub=user_id, sid=session id; API validates signature/issuer/audience/expiry and sessions revoked_at/expiry on each private request. Password Argon2id proposed m=65536KiB,t=3,p=1 with library defaults for random salt; library pin pending. Email trimmed/lowercase unique. Refresh random32bytes, SHA256 hash only DB, cookie HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax Path=/api/auth MaxAge7days; rotation locks session, revokes old and issues new same family; reuse revokes family, logout family, reset all sessions. Dev localhost HTTPS setup required before enabling secure-cookie flow; no weakened production config. Cookie-auth refresh additionally rejects Origin other than configured same origin; FE sends credentials, token stays in memory, no localStorage. Forgot-password always202 generic, random32bytes base64url reset email Mailpit(dev), hash DB,1h expiry,single-use; reset atomically consumes token/changes password/revokes sessions. Never log tokens. Proposed rate limits:5 failed logins/IP/15min,3 reset requests/IP/hour ->429. Registration DOB civil date America/Argentina/Buenos_Aires must compute age>=18; DOB private self-declaration, no stronger identity claim. Profile phone libphonenumber-js full metadata parses AR international E.164, isValid AND getType=MOBILE, fixed or FIXED_LINE_OR_MOBILE/unknown422; FE applies same library/metadata rule, server authoritative. This validates classification, not possession or WhatsApp account. Description plain text, escape rendering, never dangerouslySetInnerHTML. Public DTO permits intentional WhatsApp contact link only; exclude email,DOB,hashes,sessions,owner IDs and billing details. Ownership selected through sessions, no client user_id. Nonowned photo404; expired plan does not disable authenticated profile management.

contract.photos: Proposal: max5 photos/profile, max5242880bytes/file, JPEG/PNG/WebP only, max4096x4096 and max16777216 decoded pixels. Upload streaming size cap before full buffering; signature/magic bytes sniff then sharp decode with limitInputPixels and reject animation/multipage/corrupt files; reencode static JPEG quality85 or PNG/WebP safe output, strip EXIF/metadata, validate output dimensions/bytes. Client Content-Type untrusted; unsupported/forged415, bytes413, decoded dimensions/animation422. Quarantine inaccessible publicly; only validated reencoded object key can be persisted. No SVG/script allowed, no cryptographic photo-signature requirement. Lock owned profiles row before count<=5 check and photo insert; first becomes main, partial unique photos_one_main. PUT main and DELETE lock same row, unset previous main then set within transaction; deleting main elects earliest created_at,id; final photo removal published=false, complete=false. UUID object keys generated server; no client file path. DB rollback triggers best-effort object removal; crash orphan reconciler enumerates unreferenced quarantine objects, never publishes them; after committed deletion cleanup can retry independently. Description max2000 plain text escaped; object GET only reencoded resources with nosniff and correct type.

idempotency.after_ttl: Expired scoped key can purge. If subscription active409 active_subscription with no extension; if expired a new simulated30d activation can create201. After TTL original replay guarantee ends; key in another account independent.
idempotency.payload_hash: SHA256 of complete accepted normalized JSON {plan_id}; reject unknown fields. Hash is NOT UNIQUE, account scope in composite PK.
idempotency.same_payload: Within24h return stored ORIGINAL status201 and exact same JSON response_body, same id/starts_at/ends_at; no new row or extension. Compare payload BEFORE active check.

subscriptions.restart: Read persisted starts_at/ends_at and idempotency response; restart never recreates/renews. Derived active iff starts_at<=server now<ends_at.
transaction: Before parsing any input: NODE_ENV=production returns403 simulation_disabled, zero auth/body/catalog/DB writes. Only server configured dev or staging allowed; unknown environment fails closed.

Authenticate owner; validate Idempotency-Key, JSON object exactly {plan_id}; reject unknown keys400 and unknown/disabled plan422. Server catalog ARS snapshot; origin=simulated. Never accept price/user_id/origin/simulated.
BEGIN; SELECT id FROM users WHERE id=:session_user_id FOR UPDATE; row exists. All subscription writers, including future Rebill handler, must take same users lock.

Read idempotency row scoped(user_id,key). If expires_at>transaction_now compare SHA256 canonical JSON of full accepted payload: sorted UTF8 keys, plan_id exact string, no whitespace. Same hash: return stored status/body after COMMIT, no mutation. Different hash: ROLLBACK and409 idempotency_conflict.
If expired: delete scoped row in transaction. If EXISTS subscription starts_at<=now AND ends_at>now, COMMIT purge and return409 active_subscription, without new subscription or extending dates.

Otherwise create subscription UUID; starts_at=one transaction timestamp, ends_at=starts_at+30*24h UTC (technical test default). Insert idempotency scope/hash/status201/body full Subscription DTO/expires_at=now+24h, in SAME transaction.

COMMIT before responding201. Any precommit error ROLLBACK both subscription and response;503 transaction_failed. If commit result is uncertain, no blind repeat by controller; owner may retry same key to reconcile stored201/body.
